disputes.reason: Statement refers to 'all three review areas' without naming them, so a student without the source cannot judge it; it also bundles four separate claims (reputation reduces depth, review before engagement, three areas, technical experts and stakeholders).

Bundles a definition with a case figure, and the figure is imprecise: the USD 920 million was JP Morgan's combined resolution with the CFTC, DOJ and SEC, not an amount paid to the CFTC alone, so a candidate could reasonably call the statement false as written.
